# THREE REEL VIDEO POKER MACHINE - J. Panos - DREAMER 3 pp.10-11 (PDF pages 12-13; 03B0-03FF is
# printed at the bottom of the ALIEN page) - CHIP-8 0080-03FF (printed range 0080-0400)
# run C000 (FN 3). F spins the reels and costs 1 point (no play at score 0). Starting score at 0201
# (32 = 50 decimal). Pays: 9,-,- 2; 9,9,- 5; 10,10,10 / 10,10,A 10; J,J,J / J,J,A 10; Q,Q,Q / Q,Q,A 14;
# K,K,K / K,K,A 18; A,A,A / 7,7,7 150. After A,A,A or 7,7,7 the jackpot is not added until a key:
# C cancels the jackpot, A adds it to the score (the score wraps to 0 at 256).
# Corrections:
# - DREAMER 9 p.11 (improvement by J. Panos, against 9s showing continuously after loading and cards
#   slow to show): 0202 CA0F -> C80F, 0204 CB0F -> CD0F, 0206 CC0F -> CE0F, 027E 72FF -> 7201,
#   0286 3200 -> 3220. APPLIED below.
# - 00D0 printed D458: every other card draw is D45B (11-row card sprites spaced 0B apart from 0366),
#   so D458 -> D45B (typewriter 8/B).
# Unchecked reading: 03B8 38B8 (sprite data, kept as printed).
